description:
Cosmos is a video library for marketing and content teams. This plugin lets you work with your organization's Cosmos Library from ChatGPT.

- Search your library by topic, optionally narrowed to one client. Results point to the exact moment that matches, with a link that opens it in Cosmos.
- Get a video's AI-generated description, tags, and Library details such as client, type, style, length, and aspect ratio.
- Find videos that look similar to one you already have.
- Summarize the library: how many videos and hours it holds, how often its public share pages have been visited, and how many of its videos you have opened.
- Create a public share link for a video so people outside your team can watch it without signing in. You confirm each share, and you can password-protect or turn off any link in Cosmos.

You sign in with your Cosmos account and approve access for your organization. Searching and sharing are separate permissions, and you can disconnect at any time in Cosmos Settings. The plugin cannot upload, edit, or delete videos.

Requires a Cosmos organization account.
